body:
Our Guava dependency is pretty old right now. When we bring in Iceberg as a dependency, we hit NoSuchMethodErrors when calling the Objects#toStringHelper method, which was removed in later versions of Guava. It's been replaced by MoreObjects#toStringHelper.
There's two matters to consider here:

Should we bump Guava? We're using 23.6.1: https://github.com/palantir/incubator-iceberg/pull/8
Let's minimize our use of Guava's deprecated APIs. We can start with toStringHelper and perhaps add linting rules to find others.
title: Upgrade Guava and don't use deprecated methods like Objects#ToStringHelper
